description.en:
Earlier neural language systems often depended on task-specific pipelines and fixed windows. Encoder-decoder models offered a general way to map an input sequence of one length to an output sequence of another length.

An encoder reads the source sequence into a learned representation, and a decoder generates the target sequence token by token. Training maximizes the conditional probability of the output sequence given the input. Experts generally treat sequence-to-sequence learning as the architecture that made end-to-end neural translation practical before attention and Transformers. It also generalized to summarization, dialogue, parsing, and other structured generation tasks.
description.zh:
早期神经语言系统往往依赖任务专用流程和固定窗口。编码器—解码器模型提供了一种通用方法，可以把一个长度的输入序列映射为另一长度的输出序列。

编码器读取源序列并形成学习到的表示，解码器再逐词生成目标序列。训练目标是在给定输入的条件下最大化输出序列的条件概率。专家通常把序列到序列学习视为在注意力和 Transformer 之前推动端到端神经机器翻译走向实用的关键架构。它也扩展到摘要、对话、解析等结构化生成任务。
